title: devwork · tasks/<id>/prompt.md — the flight plan of a task, frontmatter only. The body is XML sections from scaffolds/prompt.md: <role>, <objective>, <context>, <output_format> required, the rest optional.
description: Ruled by Calo 2026-10-02 (factory-redesign logbook 75): a reference template usable in part, with a few minimum fields. The prompt points at the task context.md, the badge, and never copies it (DRY).

role.description: one line: who executes this prompt

context.description: absolute path of the task context.md, the badge this prompt runs under

para.description: the only human field, in Spanish

verify.description: the exact command that checks the result

pass_when.description: what verify must show: a count, a diff, a file:line; never 'works'

rollback.description: required in practice when the prompt emits a write: the inverse write, or the SELECT that captures the prior value

output.description: the exact artifact and its format
